name: M7.Presentation.candidates_sound
statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (L : κ → Finset σ) (R : κ → Finset τ) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), a ∈ M7.Presentation.candidates K L R → M7.Presentation.valid K L R a
guidance: Unfold candidates; Finset.mem_biUnion identifies the outer k; split the nonempty test. Singleton equality identifies a with the two independent min values, whose membership follows from Finset.min'_mem. No product traversal is in candidates. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
